title: 第一卷 第3章 老夫子的过往第一卷 第4章 仙骨
content_zh:
时间一晃就是两日之后。
明日，就是仙门前来招收弟子的日子。
这一日傍晚，天边的夕阳无比之红，随后太阳极速落下，黑夜降临。
林罪躺在床上，心中有点激动，明日就是决定他未来的日子。
怎么也睡不着。
随后他拿出坐忘石，虽然其貌不扬，但不得不说是个好东西。
可以让他快速的冷静下来。
“罪哥！”
忽然，黑虎的声音在门外响起。
林罪翻身下床，打开门。
月光下，露出黑虎那张憨厚的脸。
“怎么了？”林罪问道。
黑虎一脸笑意，手搭在林罪的肩膀上，“罪哥，我发现了一个好地方。”
“什么好地方？”
“一窝野鸡，就在村子外头那片老林子里。”
林罪眼睛一亮，他已经很久没有见荤腥了。
而且在安阳村，黑虎是他最信任的人之一，从小穿一条裤衩长大。
随即套上外衣，“走。”
……
村道上一片漆黑，黑虎走在前面，步子很快，林罪跟在后面，一开始还能借着月光看清路，走着走着，周围的景物就变了。

他们已经出了村子。
“黑虎，还有多远？”
“快了快了，就在前面，”黑虎头也不回。
林罪没有多问，只是脚下的步子慢了几分。
他注意到一件事。
黑虎走得太快了，平时这小子可不是这样。
往常一起出去打猎，黑虎隔一会儿就要回头看看他跟上没，有时候还会停下来等他。
林罪的心起了涟漪。
他又走了几步，停了下来。
“黑虎。”
黑虎也停下来，慢慢转过身。
月光照在他的脸上，那张脸还是那张脸。
“咋了，罪哥？”黑虎的声音没有太大的区别。
“太晚了，明天仙门就要来招收弟子了，我们先回去吧！！”
说完，林罪转身就要往回走。
下一秒。
content_en:
Time flies and it is two days later.
Tomorrow is the day when the Immortal Sect comes to recruit disciples.
In the evening of this day, the sunset on the horizon was extremely red, and then the sun set rapidly and darkness fell.
Lin Zui was lying on the bed, feeling a little excited. Tomorrow was the day that would determine his future.
I can't sleep no matter what.
Then he took out the Zuowang Stone. Although it looked ugly, it had to be said that it was a good thing.
It can calm him down quickly.
"Brother Zui!"
Suddenly, Black Tiger's voice sounded outside the door.
Lin Zui got out of bed and opened the door.
Under the moonlight, Black Tiger's honest face was revealed.
"What's wrong?" Lin Zui asked.
Hei Hu smiled and put his hand on Lin Zui's shoulder, "Brother Zui, I found a good place."
"What a good place?"
"There is a nest of pheasants in the old forest outside the village."
Lin Zui's eyes lit up. It had been a long time since he had seen meat.
And in Anyang Village, Heihu was one of the people he trusted most, and he grew up wearing a pair of underpants.
Then he put on his coat and said, "Let's go."
…
It was pitch dark on the village road. Black Tiger was walking in front, walking very fast, and Lin Sui was following behind. At first, he could still see the road clearly through the moonlight, but as he walked, the surrounding scenery changed.
They have left the village.
"Black Tiger, how far is it?"
"Come on, come on, right in front," Black Tiger said without looking back.
Lin Zui didn't ask any more questions, but his steps were a little slower.
He noticed something.
Black Tiger walked too fast, this kid was not like this usually.
When we usually go hunting together, Heihu will look back every now and then to see if he is following him, and sometimes he will stop and wait for him.
Lin Zui's heart rippled.
He took a few more steps and stopped.
"Black Tiger."
Black Tiger also stopped and turned around slowly.
The moonlight shone on his face, and it was still the same face.
"What's wrong, Brother Zui?" Black Tiger's voice didn't make much difference.
"It's too late. The Immortal Sect will come to recruit disciples tomorrow. Let's go back first!!"
After saying that, Lin Zui turned around and walked back.
The next second.
